notes.zh: 极大非常短暂，只有几个小时；2026 年极大正值满月，月光干扰严重。
notes.en: The peak is very brief (a few hours); in 2026 it falls at Full Moon, with strong moonlight interference.

notes.zh: 速度中等，偶有明亮火流星；极大时刻存在年际差异。
notes.en: Medium speed with occasional bright fireballs; peak timing varies from year to year.

visibleFrom.zh: 北半球为主，赤道两侧均可见
visibleFrom.en: Mainly northern, visible on both sides of the equator

names.zh: 宝瓶座 η 流星雨

notes.zh: 黎明前观测最佳，流星速度很快；2026 年极大受渐亏凸月干扰。
notes.en: Best before dawn; very fast meteors; the 2026 peak is disturbed by a gibbous waning Moon.

visibleFrom.zh: 南半球与低纬度地区最佳（黎明前）
visibleFrom.en: Best from southern and low latitudes (before dawn)

names.zh: 南鱼座 δ 流星雨

parent.zh: 未完全确定（可能与 96P/Machholz 彗星群相关）

notes.zh: 南半球与低纬地区更佳；与摩羯座 α 流星雨同期出现。
notes.en: Better from southern and low latitudes; active at the same time as the alpha Capricornids.

visibleFrom.zh: 南半球与低纬地区最佳
visibleFrom.en: Best from southern and low latitudes

names.zh: 摩羯座 α 流星雨

notes.zh: 数量少但速度慢、常有明亮的火流星，值得耐心等待。
notes.en: Low rates but slow meteors with frequent bright fireballs; worth waiting for.

visibleFrom.en: Visible from both sides of the equator

notes.zh: 2026 年极大恰逢新月，无月光干扰；传统宽峰为 8 月 12 日 21:00 至 13 日 09:00 UT。
notes.en: The 2026 peak falls at New Moon with no moonlight interference; the traditional broad maximum runs Aug 12 21:00 to Aug 13 09:00 UT.

visibleFrom.zh: 北半球为主，中纬度最佳
visibleFrom.en: Mainly northern; mid-northern latitudes are best

notes.zh: 速度很快，常有明亮流星；极大前后数夜活动相近。
notes.en: Fast meteors, often bright; activity stays similar for several nights around the peak.

visibleFrom.zh: 南北半球均可（午夜后最佳）

notes.zh: 流星速度极快；2026 年为正常水平，无爆发预期。
notes.en: Extremely fast meteors; 2026 is a normal return with no outburst expected.

notes.zh: 一年中最稳定可靠的流星雨，明亮流星多；宽峰持续 10 小时以上，2026 年几乎无月光干扰。
notes.en: The most reliable major shower with many bright meteors; broad peak lasts 10+ hours and 2026 is nearly moon-free.

visibleFrom.zh: 南北半球均可，北半球更佳
visibleFrom.en: Both hemispheres, better from the north

notes.zh: 活动易波动，偶有爆发；2026 年极大前两天满月，月光干扰明显。
notes.en: Activity is variable with occasional outbursts; Full Moon two days before the 2026 peak causes strong interference.

visibleFrom.zh: 北半球（辐射点接近天北极）
visibleFrom.en: Northern hemisphere (radiant near the north celestial pole)
